 Job Description: 
 Johnson & Johnson RAD (Robotics and Digital) is seeking for a Operations Process Engineer– OTTAVA, for our Santa Clara, Location.

 About MedTech Surgery   

 Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we're developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

 Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that's reimagining how we heal? Our Surgery team will give you the chance to deliver surgical technologies and solutions to surgeons and healthcare professionals around the world. Your contributions will help effectively treat some of the world's most prevalent conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular disease and cancer. Patients are waiting.
 Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech 
 
 Purpose 
  
 The Operations Process Engineer supports manufacturing execution for the OTTAVA Capital System production line. This hands-on, shop-floor role serves as the first line of technical support for manufacturing test and system integration activities. The engineer will partner with Manufacturing, Test, Quality, and NPI Engineering to maintain production continuity and product quality. The role supports integration of robotic subsystems into completed capital systems, troubleshooting of manufacturing process and test failures, root cause identification, and quality system execution.
  
 Key Role Responsibilities 

 Manufacturing Test and System Integration Support Responsible for ensuring uninterrupted manufacturing operations, and escalating issues when appropriate.
 Support manufacturing activities associated with system integration and test.
 Work directly with Manufacturing Associates and cross-functional engineering partners to identify and resolve technical issues affecting safety, quality, delivery, or production continuity.
 
 
 Test Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis Investigate manufacturing test failures using structured troubleshooting and problem-solving methods.
 Troubleshoot test hardware, software, and system interfaces.
 Document findings, define containment actions, and partner with Test, NPI Engineering, and Quality on permanent corrective actions.
 Capture technical knowledge and recurring failure modes to improve troubleshooting consistency and reduce production downtime.
 
 
 Quality and Compliance 
 
 Support change controls, CAPAs, NCRs, and related quality system activities.
 Participate in nonconformance investigations, root cause analysis, impact assessments, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
 Ensure assigned manufacturing and documentation activities are performed in accordance with approved procedures and applicable quality requirements.
 
  
 Qualifications / Requirements: 

 Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
 0-2 years of relevant engineering experience. Internship, co-op, academic project, research, or laboratory experience may be considered.
 Hands-on experience with engineering testing, system integration, scripting, or technical troubleshooting through academic or professional work.
 Hands-on experience with electromechanical systems, robotic systems, complex capital equipment, or integrated hardware/software products.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical writing, and communication skills.
 Ability to work effectively with Manufacturing, Test Engineering, Quality, NPI Engineering, and R&D partners.
 Ability to work 100% onsite
   
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Experience with Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB, automated test systems, data acquisition tools, SQL, or manufacturing data analysis.
 Working experience troubleshooting electromechanical systems, robotic systems, complex capital equipment, or integrated hardware/software products.
 Exposure to a regulated manufacturing environments such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, aerospace, or automotive.
 Familiarity with change controls, CAPAs, NCRs, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes.
 A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to respond with urgency to production issues while maintaining quality and compliance.
